note: Header and suppression work: "AI stopped: a person replied · Resume" after the staff reply, no AI reply to "and socks?", Resume flips the header to "AI on · Pause" (aiState ready). But the AI never answers after Resume: every later customer message gets ai_silent NO_TEXT and the pill "AI left this one for the team". Cause read from the thread: the staff message sent from the Inbox composer has a UUIDv4 id (559a83e4-fb74-459b-ad27-6ccdd1ed6380, minted by crypto.randomUUID() in apps/inbox/src/components/Composer.tsx:33), while loadEpisode in apps/api/src/services/inbox/ai-engine.ts orders the episode by message.id desc assuming UUIDv7; "559a..." sorts after every "01a1..." id, so burstOf() sees the staff line as the latest line and returns an empty burst. A thread a person has replied to from the Inbox cannot be answered by the assistant again in that episode (Mark handled + a new message still works because the episode floor moves).
